build.command: pnpm build (cwd apps/zcode-cli, PATH prefixed with the isolated root pnpm turbo)
build.limitation: The source build ran on a newer Node than declared; this proves the observed interface but is not a supported-runtime certification.

identity.communityExclusion: The historical community banner zcode-app-cli ... / zcode-runtime ... is not emitted by this official CLI and must be rejected. A bare PATH zcode or version number alone does not prove source provenance.
identity.distributionBoundary: The root build script creates a separate zcode-runtime package for the unified Web runtime. Its runner serves --web/serve and is not this terminal CLI.

documentedPluginSurface.config: ~/.zcode/cli/config.json plugins.enabled plus plugins.dirs; configured local directories are enabled inline plugins.

isolatedProbes.fixture: one local plugins.dirs plugin with ordinary and disable-model-invocation skills plus one command
observed: plugins list reports demo@inline, source inline, rootPath equal to the configured plugin directory, enabled true
skills list reports both ordinary and disable-model-invocation report skills
commands list reports report and preserves argument-hint
isolatedProbes.meaning: The official skill loader does not enforce user-only semantics from disable-model-invocation; an adapter must omit a UOS skill from skills and represent it only as a command.

isolatedProbes.fixture: ordinary skill plus one projected report command with an absolute link to a stable owned resource
observed: report has zero skill-list matches while ordinary has one
commands inspect returns the exact absolute Markdown target and $ARGUMENTS body
commands inspect preserves description Report and argumentHint [topic]
isolatedProbes.meaning: One UOS-to-command representation with an absolute owned resource target is loader-visible without a model turn.

observed: plugins update exits 1 with plugin_marketplace_invalid: Unsupported or missing plugin source: ./plugins/missing
installed_plugins.json still selects demo@failure-market 1.0.0 at cache/failure-market/demo/1.0.0 and plugins list still reports it enabled
isolatedProbes.meaning: On this official build, the actual malformed-source update failure preserves the prior active record and cache.

observed: update reports 1.0.0 to 1.0.1 and plugins list rootPath changes to cache/owned-market/demo/1.0.1
uninstall removes the demo record from plugins list
isolatedProbes.meaning: Official marketplace install, successful update, and removal all work under an isolated store.

safety: Every probe used a temporary HOME and ZCODE_STORAGE_DIR, ran no model prompt, and printed no credentials.
